# Omni Analytics

> > Omni Analytics is an AI-powered business intelligence platform built on semantic layers, offering self-service analytics, embedded dashboards, and deep integrations with Snowflake, dbt, and modern data stacks.

Omni provides a code-first BI platform that combines SQL-based semantic modeling with AI assistants like Blobby, enabling product teams and data professionals to build scalable analytics workflows. The platform emphasizes developer productivity, aggregate awareness for query performance, and embedded analytics solutions for customer-facing applications.

## Key Topics

- Business Intelligence (BI)
- Self-Service Analytics
- Embedded Analytics
- AI Analytics & Agentic AI
- Semantic Layer & Data Modeling
- SQL & Query Optimization
- Snowflake Integration
- dbt Integration
- Aggregate Awareness
- Apache Arrow
- Open Semantic Interchange (OSI)
- MCP Server
- Customer Health Scoring
- Data Stack Architecture
- Workbooks & Dashboards
